name: CJ Heres
biography: ( ) is an IT systems manager and security consultant who works with a simple philosophy: using a simple approach, one can solve most complex problems. CJ's recent work has been heavily focused on consumer electronics including Blu-Ray players, thermostats, Smart TVs, media streaming devices such as the Roku and Google TV, DVR's, and everything inbetween. CJ has previously spoken at DEF CON 20 and 21, as well as B-Sides Boston 2013.
